hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'gh pr create'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/packages/review" && printf '%s' "$input" | mix review gate; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 2 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi; echo 'The review gate (mix review gate, in packages/review) failed to run, so the pull request is refused. Fix the error above and try again.' >&2; exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that this change was reviewed
